tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250bde chen zhing sgrub kyi bka' srung gsol mchod 'grigs chags su bris pa yod: 1$0000300ྈྈྈ gu ru rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo:

zangs lcags snod du gtor ma ni: zur gsum mtho gang tsam zhig la: mdun du zur gsum mkhyud gang bca': g.yas g.yon sor bzhi tsam pa gnyis: dkar dmar rgyan dang ldan pa bsham: hūm̐: snang ba mtha' yas bka' srung ba: bdud po nag po seng ge'i gdong: nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: ber gsol g.yas pas phyar dar la: g.yon pas dmar gtor dgra la 'phen: chibs su rta nag rkang gsum 'chib: yum ni dmar mo seng gdong ma: kha ṭ+wāṃ tsit+ta phyag na 'dzin: rta dmar 'chibs pa'i g.yas g.yon du: bam ro pho mo dang bcas gsal: hūm̐: 'og min dur khrod chen po dang: rtsub 'gyur tshal dang bsil ba'i tshal: dur khrod brgyad dang nyer bzhi'i gnas: gtsug lag chos 'khor bzhugs gnas nas: zhing skyong 'khor bcas spyan 'dren no: gtso 'khor 'tsham pa'i gdan la bzhugs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin dang: rang rang mthun pa'i rdzas kyis bskang: sman raka gtor ma 'bul gyis bzhes: oṃ siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ si na ra ma hūm̐ phaṭa: tri hring dzaḥhūm̐ phaṭa: tri hriṃ dzaḥrbad rbad: ba liṃ ta khā hi khā hi: hūm̐: sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru: khas blangs sangs rgyas bstan pa srung: mthu stobs nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam: zhing skyong 'khor bcas bdag gis bstod: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes: phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pa dang: gang bcol las rnams 'grub par mdzod: zhing skyong thugs kar zla ba'i steng: hūm̐ mthar yab sngags g.yas su 'khor: yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng: bh+yo mthar yum sngags g.yon du 'khor: bam ro pho mo'i snying gar tri: de mthar rang sngags g.yas g.yon 'khor: de gnyis yig mgo thur bstan no: bdag gi zhal nas bka' bsgo'i tshul: yab sngags 'bru bdun bzlas pa yis: yab yum sngon gyi dam tshig dran: rnal 'byor khyed cag 'khor bcas kyi: bar chad thams cad sel ba dang: chos mthun bsam pa bdag gis bsgrub: nam zhig dus babs 'pho ba'i tshe: bde ba can gyi zhing khams su:

sngon nas bsu zhing rgyab nas skyel: zhes gsungs khas blangs dam bcas bsgom: yab sngags phreng skor ya zung bsnyen: de nas gtor 'bul byed 'dod na: dmar gtor chung ngu gcig bran la: na mo: dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum: bde chen zhing du bzhugs pa yi: lha tshogs kun gyi bden pa dang: zhing skyong yab yum mthu stobs kyis: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi: tshe srog bsod nams la gnod cing: phyi ma bde chen zhing khams su: 'gro la bar du gcod byed pa'i: dgra bgegs bdud dang 'byung po'i tshogs: dmar chen gtor ma 'di nyid la: khug cig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥphaṭa: zhing skyong yab yum 'khor bcas kyi: zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: dpal ldan zhing skyong sku mdog nag: dbu ni seng ge'i dbu can la: phyag g.yas ru mtshon dgra la 'debs: g.yon pas bhan+dha dgra snying 'dzin: ber chen nag po sku la gsol: bdud rta nag po'i steng na bzhugs: de yi g.yas su bam ro pho: sku mdog nag po spre 'u'i mgo: lag pa bya sder sar brdzis pas: ri rab ldig ldig 'byung bar nus: rkang pa spre 'u'i rkang pa de: nam mkhar bkyags pas lha rnams sngangs: rkang pa'i steng du dmar gtor khyer: dgra la 'phangs pas bdun rgyud gcod: zhal nas me lce 'bar ba yis: dgra bo'i mi mkhar 'ur gyis sreg: seng gdong g.yon du dza ka dza: sku mdog dmar mo me yi mdog: g.yas pas ru mtshon 'tshubs pa yis: snang srid thams cad dbang du sdud: g.yon pas tsit+ta 'dzin pa yis: dgra rgyud gtan nas brlag par nus: de yi g.yon du bam ro mo: sku mdog de ni dmar mo la: mgo ni spre 'u'i gdong can no: lag pa bya sder sar brdzis pas: ri rab ldig ldig 'byung bar nus: rkang pa spre 'u'i rkang pa de: nam mkhar bkyags pas lha rnams sngangs: rkang pa'i steng du dmar gtor khyer: dgra la 'phangs pas bdun rgyud gcod: zhal nas me lce 'bar ba yis: dgra yi mi mkhar 'ur 'ur sreg:

seng gdong yab yum 'khor dang bcas: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes: sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad sol: dgra jag chom rkun 'tshe ba zlog: dam sri bgegs kyi gnod pa zlog: pha rol byad dang rbod gtong zlog: yams nad rims nad dal kha zlog: bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod: gong gi sngags ring yongs rdzogs ni: bdun nam nyer gcig brjod la phul: gtso 'khor bzhi po skad cig la: stong gsum srid gsum lan gsum bskor: gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad nas: rang gi sgrub khang de nyid la: lan gsum bskor ba byas nas kyang: rang gi rgyab kyi phyogs bzhugs nas: sgrub pa'i rgyab rten byed par bsgom: bde chen zhing sgrub bka' srung 'di// sgrub pa'i cha lag tshang ba'i phyir// dge slong rā ga a s+ya yis// bya lo lo sar tshes gcig gi /phyi dro'i cha la bsgrigs pa ste// yig mkhan dge slong sbyin pas byas// nyes 'gal chos skyong nyid la bshags/ dge bas gnam chos bstan pa ni// gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin 'phel rgyas shog /maṅga laṃ/// /
